rows.definition: SharedTokenPool.FitPoolToAvailableMemory (internal/ctxmmu/allocator.go) fits an already-constructed pool to an explicit available-GTT byte budget: it sets totalGTTBytes to the budget, clamps maxTokens down to availableGTTBytes/bytesPerToken (never up), refreshes downscaleFactor from HALOGEN_KV_POOL_FIT on legacy non-explicit-capacity pools while explicit-capacity pools retain their supplied factor, and returns the new effective maximum token capacity.
rows.distinction: It is the byte-budget fitter applied to an existing pool; it does not detect the device class (IsIntegratedDevice / EnvHalogenIGPU gate that), does not read /proc/meminfo (ProbeMemAvailable does), and does not orchestrate the integrated-GPU sizing path (FitIntegratedKVPool does).

rows.definition: FitIntegratedKVPool (internal/ctxmmu/igpu_sizing.go) is the integrated/UMA KV sizing entrypoint: it gates on IsIntegratedDevice (HALOGEN_IGPU override wins, non-Linux defaults to discrete, Linux uses the nvidia-marker/meminfo heuristic), probes the kernel MemAvailable fact via ProbeMemAvailable, computes the effective budget with EffectiveFreeForIntegratedDevice = max(cudaFree, min(memAvailable, total)), and drives SharedTokenPool.FitPoolToAvailableMemory with that fact; discrete devices return before touching the pool or the probe.
rows.distinction: It is the integrated-device gate plus probe orchestration around the generic fitter; it is not the fitter itself (FitPoolToAvailableMemory fits any pool to any byte budget), not the pure formula (EffectiveFreeForIntegratedDevice), and not the detection override env (HALOGEN_IGPU).

rows.definition: EnvHalogenKVPoolFit = "HALOGEN_KV_POOL_FIT" (internal/ctxmmu/allocator.go) is the operator environment knob that carries the KV pool downscale ratio: a valid positive float read at pool construction seeds SharedTokenPool.downscaleFactor (default 1.0), and legacy non-explicit-capacity pools re-read it inside FitPoolToAvailableMemory; the factor proportionally shrinks the fitted pool capacity.
rows.distinction: It is a unitless RATIO knob consumed during pool fit; it does not gate integrated-device detection (that is HALOGEN_IGPU / EnvHalogenIGPU), does not carry a byte budget, and is not a sizing function.
